items.reason: app.component.html renders <app-bar *ngIf=isAuthenticated$> above the root <router-outlet>. The '404' route (app.module.ts) has no guard, and '**' redirects to it. A user with a valid token gets isAuthenticated=true and user loaded (auth.state.ts CheckAuth, then GetUserInfo), so the app-bar *ngIf=user$ block shows. Its 'Account Settings' button has routerLink="/user-settings", which resolves to the auth module route 'user-settings' (UserSettingsComponent). That route's AuthGuard always returns true.

ProjectContainerComponent is the routed component of ':projectId' (projects.module.ts), so it is rendered on s. Its sidebar (inside *ngIf=project$, true once the project loads) has routerLink="terms". That link is relative to the container's route and resolves to /projects/:projectId/terms (TermsListComponent). Caveat: the bare URL /projects/X does not stay put. The child '' redirectTo 'translations' sends it on to /projects/X/translations, but the same container and link are still shown.

/projects is behind AuthGuard, and a user on it with a valid session is authenticated, so app.component shows <app-bar> above the root outlet. Its Account Settings button has routerLink="/user-settings", which goes to UserSettingsComponent.

The 'import' child (ImportContainerComponent) is behind CanGuard, which lets Admin and Editor roles in, so a user can be on it. It renders inside ProjectContainerComponent's <router-outlet> (line 102). That container's sidebar has routerLink="settings", relative to the ':projectId' route, which resolves to /projects/:projectId/settings (ProjectSettingsComponent).
